prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an ORIGINAL production pixel-art garden object SPRITE SHEET for a 32-pixel top-down WorkAdventure event map, inspired by the warm detailed farming RPG look requested by the user, without copying any named game's artwork. Create a transparent PNG square sheet with exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of evenly spaced isolated sprites, sixteen individual objects total, each in its own equal square cell. All cells have generous transparent padding and absolutely no overlapping neighboring object. All objects face the same classic 3/4 top-down pixel RPG camera. No ground tiles, no scene, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no logos, no watermark. Strict crisp pixel art, hand-placed square pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no blur, no painterly shading, no vector icon look. Rich but restrained greens, moss, jade, warm bark, occasional cream/pink/lavender flowers; 5–8 discrete color shades per object and subtle consistent down-right shadows. Native scale: trees should work as 64×96 pixel objects, small shrubs and flowers as 32×32 or 64×32, with dense readable leaf clusters rather than flat blobs. The trees occupy roughly the same visual height within their cells, and all object bases align consistently. Exact row-major contents: ROW 1: a lush round deciduous garden tree; an elegant white-barked birch with green leaves; a small flowering tree with light pink blossoms and visible trunk; a compact rich green fir tree. ROW 2: a low rounded shrub with many leafy pixel clusters; a blueberry shrub with tiny blue berries; a lavender flowering bush; a broad decorative fern. ROW 3: a small hosta plant; a white daisy flower patch; a red tulip patch; a mixed wildflower patch. ROW 4: an irregular grass tuft; a clover patch; a small mossy gray stone cluster; a tiny grouping of natural red-capped mushrooms. Make everything polished, organic and suitable for a beautiful cozy campus garden in a real pixel game. Transparent background must be genuinely alpha, not a baked checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 16-bit pixel-art game building sprite sheet for VarCamp Myanmar's modern technology campus. Create exactly FOUR separate south-facing buildings on a truly transparent background in a strict 2 by 2 equal-cell grid, generous transparent gutters. Same fixed orthographic three-quarter top-down RPG camera for all four, no isometric diamond perspective. Each is a real modern single-storey speaker pavilion with shallow flat roof, glass side wings, a visibly wide OPEN central doorway on the bottom south edge, two glazed window bays left/right, neat timber or stone facade, small clean cyan technology accents. Family variations: top left warm timber and glass, top right pale stone and glass, bottom left navy metal and glass, bottom right warm timber garden glasshouse. Keep each building upright and symmetrical with an exactly centered open entrance, no stairs extending forward, no front fence, no poles. Buildings should have near-square overall sprite bounds, a visible shallow roof above the upper wall, and the entrance extends to the bottom edge of the building. Target game footprint each 12 by 12 tiles, 384x384 pixels at final export; the center doorway occupies exactly the central two tiles of the bottom row, with solid facade wings on each side. Detailed crafted pixels and clusters, readable windows, warm inviting interiors glimpsed through glass, clean VarCamp baseline style. TRUE crisp pixel art, limited coherent palette, no painterly smudges, no blurry gradients, no antialias effect. No baked-in text, numbers, logos, zodiac glyphs or separate signs; the game overlays its own approved room signage. No people, trees, vehicles, ground tiles or surroundings. No tents, no huts, no tall pitched triangle roofs, no gold Greek ornaments. Entire subjects safely inside their equal cells; transparent space around all four. Original designs, do not imitate or copy any commercial game artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless native pixel-art grass tile texture sheet for a polished farming RPG campus, compatible with 32x32 game tiles. Produce a square PNG sheet as a strict TWO BY TWO equal-cell grid, no gaps, no outlines between cells. Exactly four fully opaque grass textures, same gentle deep natural emerald-green base and same scale, each separately seamless on all four edges. Top left quiet short grass, top right slightly varied short grass with a few tiny lighter blades, bottom left quiet mossy short grass, bottom right a few tiny clover leaf specks. Keep contrast gentle so trees and player sprites remain clear. Fine restrained 16-bit pixel clusters, NOT a photo, NOT 3D. At final native 32x32 each tile should read as small tufts and flecks with mostly calm solid ground. No large plants, no flowers, no rocks, no paths, no soil patches, no border, no text or labels, no visible tile grid, no transparent areas. Original coherent texture, not copied from any existing game. All four cells must match the same base green and tile together without obvious edge seams.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this generated original building family sprite sheet to fix its GAME GEOMETRY. Preserve the same four modern materials and inviting windows, but transform the camera into a proper overhead 3/4 TOP-DOWN 16-bit RPG map building camera. Each individual building must occupy a nearly SQUARE sprite silhouette (width equal to height), not a wide frontal elevation. The flat roof should extend BACK toward north and occupy roughly the upper TWO THIRDS of the sprite, while the south facade occupies the lower third. Four near-square separate buildings in a strict 2×2 grid on a square transparent canvas. Each doorway must be exactly centered horizontally at the bottom south edge, and its opening WIDTH must be ONE SIXTH of the entire building width. At native export each building will be384×384, so the centered opening must be64px wide occupying x160..223, ending at y383; opaque front walls immediately on either side. No steps protruding beyond bottom edge, no planter across doorway. Keep roof modern and shallow flat, its visible top surface much deeper due to overhead camera. Crisp obvious pixel-art clusters and hard edges with no blurred textures; transparent gutters between subjects. No text, labels, people, separate surroundings, tents or triangle roofs. Exact same four designs/material order: warm timber, pale stone, navy metal, green glasshouse. Preserve actual alpha, no checkerboard background.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. This is a narrowly scoped technical matte cleanup of an approved original game sprite sheet, NOT a redesign. Remove ONLY the stray detached vivid pure-red, yellow, cyan and blue colored matte fringes and specks OUTSIDE the four actual building silhouettes. Make those outside pixels truly transparent. Preserve every building pixel subject, roof, facade, doorway, glass, rooftop garden, furniture, light, chair and all genuine interior detail. Keep the EXACT same four square cells, same cell order, exact same building silhouettes and proportions, exact same camera angle, exact same colors/materials and current centered south door positions. Do not move or rescale any of the four buildings. Do not erase legitimate yellow/green garden flowers or warm interior lights; remove only artificial saturated specks outside the cutout contours. Preserve the 2×2 sheet layout and source canvas dimensions, transparent gutter and background. Hard clean pixel-art cutout edges; no outlines added, no shadows added, no new objects, no labels, no text, no creative changes. The result should visually match the source except that detached colored background/matte contamination around the outer edges is gone.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL production 16-bit pixel-art game potted vegetation sprites for a lush modern technology campus. Exactly FOUR isolated sprites on a truly transparent background in a strict2×2 equal-cell grid with wide transparent gutters. Top left: elegant tall ornamental fountain grass, long natural green blades in a small warm terracotta cylindrical pot, vertical sprite intended32×64px. Top right: compact white-and-yellow daisy flowers with lush leaves in a small ivory ceramic pot, squat sprite intended32×32px. Bottom left: tall arching fern in a muted navy/slate pot, vertical sprite intended32×64px. Bottom right: compact purple lavender flowers in a small pale ceramic pot, squat sprite intended32×32px. Same fixed 3/4 overhead RPG camera and coherent natural emerald palette as a polished farming RPG, richly detailed but crisp readable pixel clusters at native size. Dark restrained outline, five to eight colors per material, no blurred antialias edges, no painterly texture, no gradient glow. Keep each complete plant and its pot entirely within its own cell, centered, safe transparent margins, base at the bottom. The pot must be clearly visible so a one-tile physical base makes sense. No soil ground patch, no trees, people, buildings, labels, text, logos or decorative frame. Original designs, no commercial game pixels copied. Transparent background, clean alpha matte with no red/yellow/cyan fringe speckles outside the plant silhouettes.
